caption: Sweet potato waffles 🤍 Soft, cozy, and perfect for babies, toddlers, and the whole family. Why we love this meal: • Naturally sweet (no added sugar) • Soft texture for little mouths • Great way to use leftover sweet potato • Works for breakfast or snack • Easy to freeze and reheat Ingredients: • ¼ cup flour • Pinch of cinnamon • 1 cup sweet potato, steamed & mashed • 2 eggs • 1 tbsp avocado oil or melted butter • 1 tsp baking powder • ¼ cup milk Directions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Cook in a waffle maker until golden and cooked through. 👉 For babies & toddlers: cut into strips or small squares once cooled.
